strings.jp: {sub:A0}が 鬼が島の{n}  えんま様を こらしめてから{n}6年の 歳月(さいげつ)が 流れた…
strings.en: Six years have passed since{n}  Momotaro taught King Enma{n}of Onigashima a lesson...

strings.jp: {c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「{kata}ケ{hira}ー{kata}ケッケッ{hira}!{n} 伐折羅(ばさら)王様!」{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「この {kata}カルラ{hira}の 顔に めんじて{n} えんま王を おゆるし{sub:C5}!」{0B}
strings.en: {c1}Karura{n}{c0}"Keeh, keh-keh-keh!{n} King Basara, sire!"{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"For my sake, I beg you,{n} forgive King Enma!"{0B}

strings.jp: {c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「えんま王が 愛だの! 友情だの!」{n}{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「わけのわからぬことを{n} ふれまわっておりますが…」{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「えんま王は 鬼族の 今日を{n} きずきあげた男で ございます!」{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「なにとぞ おゆるしを!」{n}
strings.en: {c1}Karura{n}{c0}"King Enma goes on about love! And friendship!"{n}{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"He spreads such nonsense far and wide..."{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"Yet he is the man who built the oni race into what it is today!"{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"I beg you, show him mercy!"{n}

strings.jp: {c1}伐折羅(ばさら)王{n}{c0}「えんま よ!」{n}{n}{c1}伐折羅王{n}{c0}「6年前… わしは {sub:B6}の{n} つみを とわなかった!」{n}{c1}伐折羅王{n}{c0}「{sub:B6}が いさぎよく{n} {sub:A0}とやらと 戦っ{sub:BE}だ!」{n}{c1}伐折羅王{n}{c0}「しかし! その後の{n} {sub:B6}は どうした?」{0B}
strings.en: {c1}King Basara{n}{c0}"Enma!"{n}{n}{c1}King Basara{n}{c0}"Six years ago... I did not hold your failure against you!"{n}{c1}King Basara{n}{c0}"For you fought that Momotaro fellow bravely!"{n}{c1}King Basara{n}{c0}"But! What have you done since then?"{0B}

strings.jp: {c1}伐折羅王{n}{c0}「えんま よ!」{n}{n}{c1}伐折羅王{n}{c0}「わしに もうすことは ないか?」{n}{0B}
strings.en: {c1}King Basara{n}{c0}"Enma!"{n}{n}{c1}King Basara{n}{c0}"Have you nothing to say to me?"{n}{0B}

strings.jp: {c1}えんま様{n}{c0}「王の ご命令とあらば{n} いかなる ばつも!」
strings.en: {c1}King Enma{n}{c0}"If it is Your Majesty's command, I accept any punishment!"

strings.jp: {c1}伐折羅王{n}{c0}「よかろう!」{n}{n}{c1}伐折羅王{n}{c0}「いつもながら いさぎよい!」{n}
{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「{kata}ケ{hira}ー{kata}ケッケッ{hira}!{n} ところで 伐折羅王さま!」{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「月の かぐや姫を{n} そろそろ…」{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「月を このままに しておいては{n} 鬼族にとって やっかいでは?」{0B}
strings.en: {c1}Karura{n}{c0}"Keeh, keh-keh-keh!{n} By the way, King Basara!"{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"About Princess Kaguya of the Moon... it is high time..."{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"If we leave the Moon as it is, won't it cause the oni trouble?"{0B}

strings.jp: {c1}伐折羅王{n}{c0}「月の かぐや姫か…」{n}{n}{c1}伐折羅王{n}{c0}「手を打たねば なるまい!」{n}{n}{c1}伐折羅王{n}{c0}「{kata}カルラ{hira}よ! 月へ 行け!」{n}{n}{c1}伐折羅王{n}{c0}「わが むすこ{kata}ダイダ{hira}王子も{n} つれて行くが よい!」{0B}
strings.en: {c1}King Basara{n}{c0}"Princess Kaguya of the Moon..."{n}{n}{c1}King Basara{n}{c0}"Something must be done!"{n}{n}{c1}King Basara{n}{c0}"Karura! Go to the Moon!"{n}{n}{c1}King Basara{n}{c0}"Take my son, Prince Daida, with you!"{0B}

strings.jp: かくして{n} かぐや姫のすむ 月の宮殿に{n}鬼族の 魔の手が せまった!!{n}知らせを 受けた {sub:A0}は{n}  月の牛車に とびのり{n} 月の宮殿へと むかった!{n}{n}{n}
strings.en: And so...{n} the oni's evil hand reached for{n}Princess Kaguya's Moon Palace!!{n}Hearing the news, Momotaro{n}  leapt into the Moon Ox-Cart{n} and set off for the Moon Palace!{n}{n}{n}

strings.jp: 新しい {sub:A0}の 伝説は{n}  ここから はじまる!{n}
strings.en: A new legend of Momotaro{n}  begins here!{n}

strings.jp: {c1}村人{n}{c0}「おい! 誰か{n} たおれてるぞ!」
{c1}村人{n}{c0}「{sub:A0}さん! どうなすったね!{n} {kata}キズ{hira}だらけでねっか!」
strings.en: {c1}Villager{n}{c0}"Momotaro! What happened to ya?{n} You're all cut up!"

strings.jp: {c1}村人{n}{c0}「て… て… てえへんだ!{n} はやいとこ はこんでやらねっと!」
strings.en: {c1}Villager{n}{c0}"Th-th-this is bad!{n} We gotta carry him in, quick!"

strings.jp: {c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「{kata}ケ{hira}ー{kata}ケッケッ{hira}!」{n}{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「{kata}ダイダ{hira}王子! また いちだんと{n} 腕を あげられましたな!」{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「それにしても…」{n}{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「まさか あんな 子どもに{n} えんま王が やぶれるとは…!」{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「どこに そんな力が{n} あったのでしょうな?」{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「まあ よい!」{n}
strings.en: {c1}Karura{n}{c0}"Keeh, keh-keh-keh!"{n}{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"Prince Daida! Your skill grows sharper by the day!"{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"Even so..."{n}{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"Who would have thought King Enma would lose to a mere child like that...!"{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"Where could he have found such strength?"{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"Well, no matter!"{n}

strings.jp: {c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「月の姫 かぐや!」{n}{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「{sub:B6}のことを 人間たちは{n} 神のように 信じているそうだな!」{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「その力 鬼族のために{n} つかわせて もらうぞ!」{n}{c1}{kata}カルラ{n}{c0}{hira}「これから ゆっくりとな{n} {kata}ケ{hira}ー{kata}ケッケッ{hira}! {kata}ケ{hira}ー{kata}ケッケッ{hira}!」
strings.en: {c1}Karura{n}{c0}"Kaguya, Princess of the Moon!"{n}{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"They say the humans believe in you as if you were a god!"{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"Your power will serve the oni now!"{n}{c1}Karura{n}{c0}"We'll take our time... Keeh, keh-keh-keh! Keeh, keh-keh-keh!"
